name: Octree Traversal with Min/Max Pruning
aliases: Min-Max Octree for Transparent Region Skipping
definition: An algorithm for ray tracing scalar volumes stored in an octree, using child node min/max scalar values to prune empty space and skip traversal of nodes that do not contain the target isovalue.
summary: Octree Traversal with Min/Max Pruning accelerates ray tracing by using hierarchical scalar bounds to skip nodes that cannot contain the target isovalue, embedding the acceleration structure directly within the volume data container.
